line.comment: * Adds 3.8 missiles to $ship in a smart way. Missiles are free.
* Returns a table of missiles that have been added to $ship, or null if none added.
* Also adds chaff and CCDS.
* Skip missile types that $ship already has in sufficient quantity.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Cleaned up. No longer uses race.
* Add-Ons 2.2: CCDS is now installed only for NPC ships (prevents exploits and encourages the player to invest in CCDS).
* Missile amounts are no longer randomized.
* Initialization.
* Chaff is added up to the desired amount before offensive missiles.
* Defense has priority. Stop if there is insufficient cargo space for offensive missiles.
* Expanded 2.2: Missile boats use available cargo volume.
* Mordan8 - increased desired amount of chaff.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Fixed ordering - huge ship must be first because big ship includes huge ship.
* If this ship is an M8, add 120 chaff instead since it protects other ships via its defensive missile turret.
* Add-Ons 2.0: Universal CCDS chances.
* Add CCDS only if the ship does not already have one.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Only if ship owner is NPC.
* $chanceCCDS1 drops to 50 if $ship already has another CCDS.
* Add Chaff up to the desired amount if the ship has a CCDS.
* Collect compatible missiles without duplicates.
* Expanded 2.2: Missile boats equip exclusively artillery when compatible.
* Otherwise, fall back to Fox 3, Fox 2, and Fox 1 missiles.
* Cargo volume is divided equally among selected missile types.
* Unused budget carries forward. Existing missiles count toward allocation.
* The Minotaur Raider, Phanon missile boats, and Xenon H are the only missile boats that can use the other factions' missiles.
* No compatible artillery. Fall back to conventional missiles.
* The tail is the first missile.
* Calculate the total volume available for missile allocation.
* Divide total volume equally, carrying any integer remainder.
* Add unused budget from the previous missile.
* Existing missiles count against the allocation.
* Do not add missiles if existing inventory exceeds allocation.
* Determine how many missiles the allocation allows, checked against available cargo volume.
* Temporary debugging.

line.comment: * Install missiles if at least one fits.
* Carry unused allocation to the next missile.
* Adds a set number of missiles for non-missile boats.
* Add-Ons 2.2: Random missile quantities are no longer used. Slightly lowered MK2 (12 -> 10) and MK1 (16 -> 15) quantities.
* Need $qty and $missiles.
* Add missiles up to the desired quantity, subject to cargo capacity.
* Calculate the quantity needed and the quantity that fits.
* If ship capacity is full, return.
